title: Deutsche Telekom CEO criticises EU telecom rules overhaul
title_zh: 德国电信首席执行官批评欧盟电信规则改革
summary: Deutsche Telekom chief executive Timotheus Hoettges expressed dissatisfaction ‌with how the European Union is ‌handling the reform of telecommunication sector rules ​and called for more deregulation.
summary_zh: 德国电信首席执行官蒂莫西斯·霍特格斯 (Timotheus Hoettges) 对欧盟处理电信行业规则改革的方式表示不满，并呼吁进一步放松监管。

title: US stock futures waver as Nvidia's blockbuster results draw muted response
title_zh: 由于英伟达的重磅业绩引发冷淡反应，美国股指期货波动
summary: U.S. stock index futures were muted on Thursday as Nvidia's stellar quarterly results garnered a lukewarm response from investors and downbeat earnings from software company Salesforce weighed on ‌sentiment.
summary_zh: 美国股指期货周四表现平淡，因英伟达出色的季度业绩引起投资者反应冷淡，而软件公司 Salesforce 的悲观盈利打压了市场情绪。

title: Amazon refused permission to appeal go-ahead for UK lawsuits from retailers, consumers
title_zh: 亚马逊拒绝允许零售商和消费者对英国诉讼进行上诉
summary: LONDON, Feb 26 (Reuters) - Amazon on Thursday lost its latest bid to try to throw out two mass lawsuits from retailers and consumers worth up to 4 billion pounds ($5.41 billion) for allegedly abusing
summary_zh: 路透伦敦 2 月 26 日 - 亚马逊周四试图驳回两起针对零售商和消费者的大规模诉讼，涉案金额高达 40 亿英镑（合 54.1 亿美元），但最终失败。

title: Musk touts California robotaxis but Tesla does nothing to get permits
title_zh: 马斯克大力宣传加州机器人出租车，但特斯拉没有采取任何措施来获得许可
summary: For more than a year, Elon Musk has repeatedly said Tesla is months away from launching a driverless robotaxi service in California – once state regulators give their blessing.
summary_zh: 一年多来，埃隆·马斯克(Elon Musk)多次表示，一旦州监管机构批准，特斯拉距离在加州推出无人驾驶机器人出租车服务还有几个月的时间。

title: Stock Investors Are Hedging a Drop. Strategists See a Buy Signal
title_zh: 股票投资者正在对冲下跌。策略师看到买入信号
summary: The change in mood among investors, particularly the retail crowd, arrives as the S&P 500 has churned below 7,000 for most of the year, defying predictions that a breakout is imminent.
summary_zh: 投资者（尤其是散户）的情绪发生了变化，标准普尔 500 指数今年大部分时间都在 7,000 点以下徘徊，这违背了即将突破的预测。

title: Threat to large IT firms 'overblown', Cognizant's AI chief says amid Anthropic-driven disruption
title_zh: Cognizant 人工智能主管表示，在人为驱动的颠覆中，对大型 IT 公司的威胁“被夸大了”
summary: By Haripriya Suresh MUMBAI, Feb 26 (Reuters) - Fears that new artificial intelligence tools could replace large IT services firms are "overblown" as clients still need help deploying and scaling the
summary_zh: 作者：Haripriya Suresh 孟买，2 月 26 日（路透社）——对于新的人工智能工具可能取代大型 IT 服务公司的担忧“言过其实”，因为客户仍然需要帮助来部署和扩展人工智能工具。

title: Bitcoin price rebounds after Nvidia earnings and ETF inflows
title_zh: Nvidia 财报和 ETF 资金流入后比特币价格反弹
summary: The cryptocurrency market staged a sharp turnaround over the past 24 hours, with bitcoin and major altcoins rebounding after weeks of heavy losses.
summary_zh: 加密货币市场在过去 24 小时内出现急剧逆转，比特币和主要山寨币在经历数周的严重下跌后出现反弹。

title: Gold prices to hit $6,300 by end of year, says JPMorgan
title_zh: 摩根大通称金价到年底将触及 6,300 美元
summary: Tensions between the US and Iran and uncertainty over Donald Trump's tariffs are pushing investors to gold.
summary_zh: 美国和伊朗之间的紧张局势以及唐纳德·特朗普关税的不确定性正在推动投资者转向黄金。

title: EU court adviser rejects Meta's fight against EU antitrust demands for Facebook data
title_zh: 欧盟法院顾问驳回 Meta 针对欧盟对 Facebook 数据的反垄断要求的抗争
summary: An adviser to Europe's top court on Thursday backed ‌Meta Platforms' fight against EU antitrust ‌regulators over what the U.S. tech giant said were ​aberrant requests for information from the later during two investigations into the company.
summary_zh: 欧洲最高法院的一名顾问周四支持 Meta Platforms 与欧盟反垄断监管机构的斗争，理由是这家美国科技巨头在对该公司进行的两次调查中向欧盟反垄断监管机构提出了异常的信息请求。
